summary: Frontend-only verification of the new drag-and-drop Home sections ordering feature in the admin CMS (cms-tab-homeSections). All review items pass. Default order restored at the end on both the saved CMS content and the public home.

issues: Sticky tab bar causes ~45px horizontal page overflow (document.scrollWidth - clientWidth = 45). All home-order-* buttons are still reachable within the 390 viewport (right edge ~353px). Minor; pre-existing in admin shell, not in review scope.

verified.controls_per_row: home-order-up-{id}, home-order-down-{id}, home-order-toggle-{id} all present; toggle absent on contact (confirmed).
verified.hide_toggle_works: After hiding 'press' and saving, public home sections render without press (9 sections). After unhiding and saving, press returns.
verified.save_persists_to_public: After save + reload /, public home ordering is ['founders','films','about','commercials','dna','vision','expertise','contact'] with discover+press hidden/absent — matches saved draft.
verified.preview_flow: localStorage op-preview-draft seeded by ContentEditor; /?preview=1 shows draft order ['films','about','founders','commercials','dna','vision','expertise','press','contact'] with discover hidden and the preview banner visible — before any save.
verified.hero_marquee_stay_on_top: Home.jsx renders Hero + Marquee before the order.filter().map(); confirmed visually at /?preview=1 (Hero on top, no section injected above).
verified.console_errors: Only 401s from /api/auth/me before login (expected). No runtime errors during flow.

critical_code_review_comments: HomeOrderEditor.jsx: clean HTML5 drag-and-drop plus up/down buttons and eye toggle; contact row correctly omits the hide toggle (s.id !== 'contact').
ContentEditor.jsx: debounced write of draft to localStorage[PREVIEW_KEY] (300ms) powers live /?preview=1 preview; openPreview also writes synchronously before opening.
i18n.withNewPages() dedupes + filters saved homeSections to known ids and appends any missing default sections, so legacy saved content and future added sections remain safe.
Home.jsx renders Hero + Marquee before `order.filter(s => s.show !== false && SECTIONS[s.id]).map(...)` — hidden sections are simply not mounted (good), hero/marquee always on top (good).

Minor: at 390px admin shell has sticky toolbar overflow (~45px). Not caused by HomeOrderEditor (its rows are 390-safe). Could set `overflow-x-auto` only on the tab row, or wrap the whole page body in a scrollable container to kill the body-level horizontal scroll.
seed_data_creation: none; final CMS state restored to default order with all 10 sections visible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Testids: home-order-editor, home-order-item-{id}, home-order-up-{id}, home-order-down-{id}, home-order-toggle-{id} (no toggle on contact). CMS tabs via cms-tab-{key} incl. cms-tab-homeSections. Save = cms-save-btn; Preview = cms-preview-btn (opens /?preview=1 which reads localStorage['op-preview-draft']). Public section testids used for order verification: about-section, founders-section, films-section, commercials-section, manifesto-section (dna), vision-section, expertise-section, discover-section, press-section, contact-section. Default order after this run is restored (saved to backend).
